title: ModHarness-RL: Recasting Harnesses as Learnable and Evolving Programs for Agentic RL
snippet: During RL training, candidate programs are proposed from recent trajectories, verified by execution, and replayed over past trajectories, so the harness tracks how the model's behavior shifts. We study CodeSearch in depth and further analyze ALFWorld and BIRD SQL, with models from 1.5B to 8B.

title: WaferTetris: Efficient Freeform Mapping on Wafer-Scale Accelerators
snippet: Compared with the manually optimized WaferLLM, WaferTetris supports $1.8\times$ the context length for LLaMA3.1-8B (80k versus 44k), while delivering equal or higher per-user throughput at matched context lengths, up to $1.10\times$.

title: StreamEmbed: Real-Time Indexing from Pixels for Screenshot Retrieval
snippet: A memory-efficient vector index stores a simulated year of screenshots in 0.13 GB of RAM. Together, these results make real-time indexing of screen history in its native visual form practical, laying a foundation for fully local visual assistants.
